concerns.text: T042 proposes a 'Pilot Power Estimation' to dynamically calculate N based on pilot variance. This violates SC-004 which mandates a fixed minimum sample size of N ≥ 30 per condition to ensure statistical power. A dynamic calculation risks under-powering the study if pilot variance is low, effectively weakening the success criterion.

T013 (Held-out test instance generator) is marked incomplete/unimplemented. However, T025a (Single-Task Execution Runner) and T026 (Evaluation Logic) explicitly depend on `data/test_instances.json` produced by T013 to establish baselines and calculate forgetting rates (FR-005). The task list fails to ensure the deliverable for this critical data artifact exists before downstream tasks consume it, creating a broken chain for FR-004/FR-005.

T015 requires loading `VALIDITY_THRESHOLD` from `config.py` to enforce SC-005 (validity ≥ 99%). The task description implies this constant exists but does not explicitly mandate its definition in T004a (Configuration constants) or ensure the error-code exit mechanism is implemented. Without explicit enforcement logic, the SC-005 gate is not preserved in the task deliverable.

T014 (Data writing logic) is required to write `data/checksums.json` to satisfy Constitution Principle III (Data Hygiene). The task is marked incomplete. Without this artifact, the project violates the non-negotiable reproducibility requirement before any training (Phase 4) can occur, as subsequent tasks (T005, T050) rely on these checksums.

The post-run parity verification chain (T041 → T043 → T049) is blocked by missing upstream artifacts: `data/batch_config.json` (from T042) and `parity_report.json`. T049 enforces FR-002 (post-run checksum) but cannot execute if the report generation tasks are incomplete. The task list does not resolve this dependency block, leaving FR-002 unverified.

T026 (Evaluation Logic) depends on `data/results/initial_metrics.json` from T025a. T025a depends on `data/test_instances.json` from T013. Since T013 is incomplete, T026 cannot function. This cascading failure means the core forgetting rate calculation (FR-005) has no input data path, violating the requirement to measure forgetting.
